desktop_dashboard_desc: Full-featured scrollable dashboard for desktop use with detailed analytics and controls
meeting_room_display_desc: Single-screen overview optimized for large displays and presentations
events_reporting_display_desc: Single-screen overview optimized for large displays and presentations
edit_mode_instructions: Drag the teal buttons to reorder widgets. Use the settings panel to show/hide widgets
edit_mode_instructions_meeting: Use the settings panel to show/hide widgets
google_analytics_overview_desc: Real-time analytics from Google Analytics showing user engagement metrics including sessions, page views, average session duration, and conversion rates for your tourism websites.
distribution_overview_desc: Distribution of businesses, products, and points of interest across different categories including sleep, eat, attractions, local services, travel, and cultural sites in the Western Negev region.
upcoming_events_desc: Calendar of scheduled tourism events, festivals, and activities across the Western Negev region with dates, locations, and registration status.
financial_summary_desc: Comprehensive financial metrics including voucher sales, online and offline orders, credit card transactions, and total revenue for the selected time period.
purchases_report_desc: Detailed analysis of purchase trends showing the breakdown of vouchers and credit card payments that comprise total orders, with historical comparisons and averages.
popular_content_desc: Top-performing businesses, products, and points of interest ranked by views, bookings, and engagement metrics with growth trends and podium rankings.
